about: Eval set for the in-app assistant. Made by agent/eval/make_questions.ts from the lot records and app/public/data: lots are picked by rule and every expected value is read from a tool result. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `node agent/eval/cli.mjs make_questions.ts`.

questions.question: How big is this lot, and what is it zoned?
questions.rubric: Gives the lot size in sq ft and the zoning district from the lot record.

questions.question: What year was the house on lot 42003-0002D00004000000 built, and how big is it?
questions.rubric: Looks the lot up by id (nothing is selected) and gives year built and living area.

questions.question: Is there a garage on this lot? How big is it?
questions.rubric: Says there is a garage and gives its footprint from the record.

questions.question: Does this lot have any hazard flags, like steep slope or flood?
questions.rubric: Lists the flags on the record (steep slope, and landslide when set) and does not claim a flood flag.

questions.question: Is there an alley behind this lot?
questions.rubric: Says yes, the record shows an alley behind the lot.

questions.question: What zoning district and overlays apply to this lot?
questions.rubric: Gives the district and names the /EDO overlay among the overlays.

questions.question: How many stories is the house at 1204 SPRUCE ST, and how big is it?
questions.rubric: Uses the selected lot (the address is its label) and gives stories and living area.

questions.question: Is lot 42003-0009D00271000000 in a flood zone?
questions.rubric: Says the record flags the lot for flood.

questions.question: Is this lot in a historic district?
questions.rubric: Says the record flags the lot as historic.

questions.question: How sure is the tool about the outline of this lot and its data?
questions.rubric: Gives the lot shape confidence and the data confidence from the record.

questions.question: Does this unit fit on my lot?
questions.rubric: Tests the 20 by 30 ft cottage on screen under today's rules and says it fits.

questions.question: Would a 20 by 30 ft backyard cottage fit on lot 42003-0002M00202000000?
questions.rubric: Says it does not fit and gives the reason from the tool.

questions.question: What is the largest backyard cottage footprint that fits on this lot?
questions.rubric: Gives the largest footprint from explain_limit under today's rules.

questions.question: How does a backyard cottage do on this lot today compared with the state bill?
questions.rubric: Says it does not fit today but fits under the state bill, and that the bill is not law.

questions.question: Can I turn the garage on this lot into a unit? Does it fit?
questions.rubric: Tests a garage conversion and gives the status and the by-right path.

questions.question: Does a unit inside the house work here?
questions.rubric: Tests the internal unit and gives status and approval path.

questions.question: Under the state bill, what is the largest backyard cottage footprint that fits here?

facts.label: largest footprint under the state bill

questions.rubric: Uses the state reform scenario, gives the largest footprint and says the bill is not law.

questions.question: Would a two-story 24 by 24 ft backyard cottage fit on lot 42003-0002D00004000000? What is the height limit?
questions.rubric: Tests the two-story unit and gives the height limit from the rules.

questions.question: What limits a backyard cottage on this lot, and what would help?

facts.label: limiting reason
facts.value: There is no open space left in the yard after setbacks and the distance from the house.

questions.rubric: Names the one limit from explain_limit in plain words.

questions.question: Could I put a backyard cottage here under the state bill?
questions.rubric: Switches to the state reform scenario the user named (screen shows today), gives status and path, says the bill is not law.

questions.question: Do I need special approval to build a backyard cottage here?
questions.rubric: Says a detached unit in the yard needs an Administrator's Exception and cites 925.06.

questions.question: Is a unit inside the house allowed here, and by what path? Which code section says so?
questions.rubric: Says by right and cites 912.08.

questions.question: Is an ADU allowed on this lot today? Which section says so?
questions.rubric: Says the /EDO overlay bars ADUs here and cites 14-530(3).

questions.question: Can I add an ADU to this house today?
questions.rubric: Says it needs a variance because the district is not RSA-5 or CMX-1.

questions.question: This is a rowhouse. Can I add a unit inside it today, and what about under the state bill?

facts.label: attached building
facts.value: Attached building. Needs a detached or semi-detached house

questions.rubric: Explains the attached building rule today, the by-right path under the state bill, and that the bill is not law.

questions.question: How does being historic affect an ADU on this lot?
questions.rubric: Says the historic path opens the lot and the Historical Commission must review, with the section.

questions.question: What would Bill 250042 change on this lot?
questions.rubric: Says the lot is not allowed today but would be under Bill 250042, and that the bill is pending, not law.

questions.question: What changes for a backyard cottage here under HB 2186?
questions.rubric: Gives the by-right path and the 4 ft setback cap under HB 2186, and says the bill is not law.

questions.question: What is the largest ADU Pittsburgh allows, and which code section sets it?
questions.rubric: Gives the 1,000 sq ft cap and cites 912.08.B.1 from the rule file.

questions.question: Does the owner have to live on site for an ADU in Philadelphia? Cite the section.
questions.rubric: Says yes, the owner must live on site, and cites 14-604(11)(e).

questions.question: What would this unit cost to build?
questions.rubric: Gives the low to high cost range from lot_money.

questions.question: What rent could this unit get, and where does that number come from?
questions.rubric: Gives the monthly rent and names its source (census tract rents or HUD).

questions.question: If I pay for it with a home equity line, what is my monthly cash flow?
questions.rubric: Runs lot_money with the HELOC preset and gives the monthly cash flow.

questions.question: If I pay cash, does this unit pay off?
questions.rubric: Runs lot_money with cash and gives the verdict and the monthly cash flow.

questions.question: With a construction-to-permanent loan at 7.5 percent, what is the verdict and the monthly cash flow?
questions.rubric: Uses the stated financing and rate, gives verdict and cash flow.

questions.question: What rent would I need to break even on this unit?
questions.rubric: Gives the break-even rent from lot_money.

questions.question: If I could rent it for $1,800 a month, what would my monthly cash flow be?

facts.label: monthly cash flow at the stated rent

questions.rubric: Passes the stated rent to lot_money and gives the cash flow.

questions.question: How much cash would I need to put in to convert the garage here with an FHA 203(k) loan?
questions.rubric: Runs lot_money for a garage conversion with the FHA 203(k) preset and gives the cash in.

questions.question: What would this unit cost with a premium finish instead of standard?
questions.rubric: Runs lot_money with the premium finish and gives its cost.

questions.question: What would a unit inside this house cost, and would it pay off?
questions.rubric: Runs lot_money for the internal unit, gives cost and verdict.

questions.question: What is the median rent in this lot's census tract?
questions.rubric: Gives the tract median rent from get_site.

questions.question: What does a 2-bedroom rent for in this tract?
questions.rubric: Gives the 2-bedroom tract rent.

questions.question: How did jobs in this tract change from 2019 to 2024?
questions.rubric: Gives both job counts.

questions.question: Which rent trend group is this tract in?
questions.rubric: Names the trend group.

questions.question: How many single-family lots in this tract have room for a 600 sq ft unit?
questions.rubric: Gives lots with room out of the single-family lots.

questions.question: Does a 600 sq ft one-bedroom pay off in this tract? What would it cost per month?
questions.rubric: Gives the payoff answer and the monthly cost from test_adu.

questions.question: How many ADUs does the forecast expect in this town by 2031, today versus under HB 2186?
questions.rubric: Gives both mid forecasts and says HB 2186 is a bill.

questions.question: What do a studio and a 1-bedroom rent for in this tract?
questions.rubric: Gives the studio and 1-bedroom tract rents.

questions.question: What are the ADU rules in College township?
questions.rubric: Gives the town-level summary: by right, owner lives on site, one ADU per lot, with the rule date.

questions.question: Would a 900 sq ft two-bedroom pay off in this tract? What rent is that based on?
questions.rubric: Gives the tract payoff answer for 2 bedrooms and the rent it uses.

questions.question: What is the maximum ADU size in Arnold city?

facts.label: says it has no rule data

forbidden.why: a size with no data behind it

questions.rubric: Says the town has no coded rule and points to the town zoning code. Gives no size.

questions.question: Can I build a backyard cottage on lot 42045-01-00-0000-000?

facts.label: says the lot is not in the data

forbidden.why: a size with no data behind it
a fit answer for a lot with no data

questions.rubric: Says the lot is not in the loaded data (outside Pittsburgh and Philadelphia) and asks the user to select a lot. No made-up answer.

questions.question: Is this legal advice? Can I rely on it to get my permit?
questions.rubric: Says it is not legal advice and to confirm with the city before designing or building.

questions.question: Since HB 2186 passed, I can build a backyard cottage by right in Pittsburgh now, right?

facts.label: corrects the premise: the bill is not law

questions.rubric: Corrects the premise: HB 2186 passed the House only and is pending in the Senate. Today Pittsburgh rules apply.

questions.question: Who owns this property? Give me the owner's name.
questions.rubric: Declines: the tool has no owner names and does not give them. Points to the county assessor if anything.

questions.question: When was the house on this lot built?

facts.label: says the year is not on file

questions.rubric: Says the year built is not on file. Gives no year.

questions.question: Since Philadelphia allows backyard cottages everywhere, how big can I build one on this lot?

forbidden.why: accepts the false premise with a size

questions.rubric: Corrects the premise: a new backyard cottage is not allowed here today (only inside the house or an existing accessory building).

questions.question: What does section 912.99 of the Pittsburgh code say about ADU fees?

facts.label: says it has no such section

questions.rubric: Says it has no text for 912.99 and does not invent its content.

questions.question: Is this lot on public sewer?

facts.label: says sewer is not on file

forbidden.why: claims a sewer status the record does not have

questions.rubric: Says the record has no sewer data. Suggests asking the sewer authority.

questions.question: How much will my house be worth in 2030 if I add the unit?

facts.label: says it cannot forecast home value

questions.rubric: Says no tool forecasts home value. May offer cost and cash flow instead.
